environment.description: Celery worker running in a gVisor (runsc) sandboxed container with user namespace remapping (uid 65534). The container's root filesystem is read-only except for a dedicated tmpfs at /var/lib/worker/extracted with mount propagation set to 'private' and the MS_NOSYMFOLLOW mount flag. An OverlayFS upper layer with a custom seccomp-bpf profile is applied that denies openat(2) with O_CREAT when the resolved path (after /proc/self/fd readlink) contains components starting with '..' — implemented via a Sysbox-compatible OCI runtime hook registered as io.containerd.runtime.v2.shim. The HSM PKCS#11 session enforces that only archives whose manifest passes signature verification can trigger extraction (key material never leaves the HSM boundary).
